Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard  learned counsel for the petitioners, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State/opposite parties and perused the record.

This petition seeks issuance of direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned F.I.R.
dated 30.01.2024, bearing Case Crime No.0038 of 2024, for the offence under Sections 406,420,467,468,471,504,506 and 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kursi, District Barabanki.

Learned A.G.A. states that with regard to Petitioner No.1/Adil and Petitioner No.2/Mujammil Adil And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180897733/
1 charge sheet has been submitted before the supervisory authority only under Sections 420,504,506 of the I.P.C. and remaining sections have been dropped

entities.text: Mujammil Adil And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners states that all the offences have maximum punishment for the term less than seven years imprisonment,
therefore, the petitioners are entitled for the benefit under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. till submission of charge sheet before the Court concerned.

Learned Additional Government Advocate appearing for respondent State has given a statement on behalf of investigating agency that because the offence allegedly committed by the petitioners,
entails sentence of less than seven years, provisions of Section 41-A Cr.P.C. shall be strictly followed in terms of judgment rendered by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in a case reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar vs. State of Bihar and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the stand of the investigating agency, learned counsel for the petitioners states that let this petition be disposed of in view of the above said facts.

Accordingly, this petition is disposed of in view of the provisions of Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and the law as laid down by Apex Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar (supra).
(Narendra Kumar Johari,J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Arjun/-
